description:
intent=i027 snapshot=s01 branch=pull-return-unchecked status=complete
finding location=drivers/net/wan/hdlc_fr.c:893-979 confidence=medium conclusion=fr_rx() uses unchecked skb_pull(4/5) as a linearizer after only skb->len checks and keeps dereferencing the data pointer saved before skb_share_check() (line 940), so a non-linear or shared received frame can cause a stale-head read and reads of bytes not in the linear head (medium confidence).
unresolved location=net/bluetooth/l2cap_core.c:7766 conclusion=Verify whether any HCI transport driver (drivers/bluetooth/*) can hand a non-linear skb into hci_acldata_packet/l2cap_recv_frame; if yes, lh->cid/len reads after the unchecked skb_pull(L2CAP_HDR_SIZE) touch non-linear bytes.
unresolved location=net/atm/pppoatm.c:298 conclusion=Confirm whether ATM AAL5 receive skbs (net/atm/* and drivers/atm/*) can be non-linear; if so the memcmp(skb->data, pppllc, LLC_LEN) at net/atm/pppoatm.c:199 reads beyond the linear head.
unresolved location=net/bluetooth/a2mp.c:615 conclusion=Trace l2cap_data_channel->a2mp_chan_recv_cb skb delivery to decide whether the hdr pointer saved before 'skb_pull(skb, sizeof(*hdr))' (net/bluetooth/a2mp.c:622) can be non-linear or be invalidated before the hdr->code/hdr->ident reads at 625/631.
unresolved location=net/nfc/llcp_core.c:1382 conclusion=Determine whether any NFC driver (net/nfc/nci, drivers/nfc/*) can deliver a non-linear skb to nfc_llcp_recv_agf; if yes the skb->data[0]<<8|skb->data[1] read at line 1401 is out of the linear head.
unresolved location=net/ax25/ax25_in.c:218 conclusion=Verify whether any AX.25-capable device (drivers/net/hamradio/mkiss, 6pack, yam, scc) can hand a non-linear skb to ax25_kiss_rcv; if yes, reads of skb->data[0]/[1] after the unchecked skb_pull at ax25_in.c:218 read non-linear bytes.
coverage_gap=The ~1100 pull-family sites in drivers/net/ were enumerated but only pattern-sampled (hdlc_fr.c read in full); files such as drivers/net/ethernet receive offload helpers and drivers/net/wireless were not individually audited.
coverage_gap=No runtime or KASAN reproduction was performed (read-only snapshot, no network): the fr_rx stale-data-pointer after skb_share_check and the non-linear reads are inferred from source structure, not observed.
coverage_gap=Non-linearity preconditions were assessed structurally (which subsystems linearize before parsing) rather than by tracing each hardware driver's skb allocation path (HCI transports, ATM AAL5, NFC, hamradio).
coverage_gap=The prescribed open template net/decnet/dn_nsp_in.c:130-158 (dn_process_ack) does not exist in snapshots/s01 (no net/decnet tree at all), so that exact shape could only be matched by analogy, not verified in place.
coverage_gap=Assigned sites named in prior facts (net/decnet/*, net/phonet/pep.c) were excluded or out of scope by instruction; phonet pep_get_sb was confirmed present at net/phonet/pep.c:45-66 but deliberately not reported.
limitation=All conclusions rest on static reading of snapshots/s01 exact lines; snapshot revision is opaque, so line numbers are valid only for this supplied tree.
limitation=The primary fr_rx finding's stale-pointer half depends on the received skb being shared/cloned at skb_share_check() and its non-linear half on the FRAD driver delivering frags; many WAN drivers build fresh linear skbs, in which case the code is merely fragile, not exploitable.
limitation=The five unresolved candidates (l2cap/hci_acldata, pppoatm, a2mp, llcp_agf, ax25) could not be closed because each hinges on per-driver non-linearity that a source snapshot alone does not resolve without tracing every hardware path.
limitation=The coarse scanner's statement-continuation heuristic (up to 6 lines) may have misjoined a few multi-line calls, so a small number of false positives/negatives among the 416 flagged sites cannot be excluded.
